name: @azure/chaos-studio-task
description: Thin Azure Pipelines task adapter for the Azure Chaos Studio v2 CI/CD integration. Wraps azure-pipelines-task-lib input/output/logging and an ARM service-connection (workload-identity) token source around the shared TypeScript orchestration core in packages/core. All service behavior lives in the core; this package only translates the Azure Pipelines platform surface.
